culturalBackground: Minimal mehndi uses small motifs and leaves most of the skin bare.
It is popular for everyday wear, the office and small gatherings where a heavy design would be too much.
Fine lines on the fingers, wrist or one side of the hand are the most common placements.
Most minimal designs can be applied in a few minutes.
applicationTips: Use the finest cone tip you can; thin, clean lines define the minimal look.
Decide on one focal point, such as a finger or the wrist, and keep the rest bare.
Stop earlier than you think you should; adding more is what turns a minimal design into a busy one.

faqPool.a: It is a style built on small, simple motifs with a lot of empty space, such as a single vine or a few finger bands.

faqPool.q: How long does a minimal design take?
Does minimal mehndi stain as dark as a full design?
faqPool.a: Yes. The colour depends on the paste, the skin and how long the paste stays on, not on how big the design is.
